votes.motion: Nominate Mr. Greg Roy to serve as Chair
votes.quote: mr. passios made a motion to nominate mr. greg roy to serve as chair. the motion was seconded, and the motion carried 5-0.

votes.quote: mr. passios made a motion to nominate mr. david blatt as vice-chair. the motion was seconded, and the motion carried 5-0.

votes.quote: mr. passios made a motion to nominate mr. michael mackin as clerk. the motion was seconded, and the motion carried 5-0.
